verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.slack.dev that describes the official developer docs. Slack also publishes an llms-full-deno.txt variant and markdown versions of doc pages (quickstart.md, block-kit.md, node-slack-sdk.md), plus a 'build with AI' guide, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs in practice, and no evidence on how complete llms.txt coverage is across the full doc set.
